verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs describe handing tasks off to its built-in agent, including Plan Mode for scoped work, agents that build, test and demo features end to end on their own computers, and subagents the agent can delegate to across the editor, CLI and Cloud Agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of in-product task delegation; all supporting evidence is first-party.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Accelerate development by handing off tasks to Cursor, while you focus on making decisions.
Agents use their own computers to build, test, and demo features end to end for you to review.
specialized AI assistants that Cursor's agent can delegate tasks to
Scope changes, use Plan Mode, and ship bigger work with confidence
Agents can start dev servers, open the app in a browser, click through UI flows, and verify their changes work before pushing a PR.
